> (auto generated by Claude)

`test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_hicache_sidecar_restore.py` (from #43110) builds `MambaComponent` with `object.__new__`, skipping `__init__`. #44718 added `self.host_only_checkpoint` in `__init__` and reads it in `build_hicache_transfers`, so the test now fails on main with `AttributeError: 'MambaComponent' object has no attribute 'host_only_checkpoint'` and fail-fasts `base-a-test-cpu` for every PR.

The test sets `host_only_checkpoint = False` on the bare component, the behaviour before #44718.

Validation: `/rerun-test` of the file on CPU CI.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
